# Version 0.44.0

**Date:** 2026-11-15
**Tag:** `v0.44.0`
**Range:** `v0.43.0..master`

## Why this release exists

`v0.44.0` is about speed. On Linux, Dora drew its whole interface on the CPU,
which held animations and scrolling to about 20 frames per second on large
displays. It now uses the GPU where it safely can. Across all platforms, the
interactions you repeat all day (switching tables, opening menus and dialogs,
switching connections) do a fraction of the work they did. The release also
brings a new connection dialog, illustrated empty states and a launch splash
that shows your last session.

## Changes

- **GPU rendering on Linux.** Dora picks a rendering path at startup: native
  Wayland with GPU compositing on Wayland sessions, GPU through shared memory
  on X11 displays up to 2560x1600, and software rendering elsewhere and inside
  Flatpak, Snap and AppImage. If a GPU launch never paints a frame, Dora
  restarts itself with software rendering and keeps it until the next update.
  Set `DORA_RENDERER=wayland`, `gpu` or `software` to choose yourself. The log
  names the path in use in a line starting with `Linux renderer:`.
- **Faster table switching.** Switching to a table you have already opened
  renders once instead of four times, and a background refresh that returns
  the same rows no longer re-renders the grid. Table reads take one round trip
  to the backend instead of two or more.
- **Menus and dialogs open and close in one frame.** Overlays no longer lock
  page scroll or restyle the whole app, and they close without an exit
  animation. Moving focus no longer walks the whole document.
- **Two-step connection dialog.** Paste a connection URL or search for a
  source: Dora detects the engine, provider, SSL and pooler settings, then shows
  the details form with an inline connection test and a suggested name. Saving
  an untested connection asks first.
- **Launch splash shows your last session.** The window opens on a picture of
  the shell you left, so there is no blank frame while the app loads.
- **Illustrated empty states** across the app, and a reworked onboarding tour
  with a dimmed backdrop and a card anchored to the highlighted item.

## Behaviour changes

- Menus, selects, collapsibles and tabs no longer animate. Dialogs keep a short
  fade in and close instantly.
- Escape inside the connection switcher closes the switcher only, and typing
  in its search no longer jumps between menu items.
- Toasts stay clickable while a dialog is open.

## Fixes

- A closing tooltip finishes its exit when the next one opens, instead of
  lingering.

## Known limits

- On NVIDIA drivers WebKitGTK paces frames with a 60 Hz timer, so 60 frames per
  second is the ceiling there whatever the monitor's refresh rate.
- The GPU paths were tested on NVIDIA only. If Dora shows a blank or broken
  window on Intel or AMD graphics, start it with `DORA_RENDERER=software` and
  report it.
